subject.title: [Feature]: Allow restoring rejected skill workshop proposals back to pending

question: Should rejected Skill Workshop proposals become recoverable through a core restore/reopen lifecycle action across service, Gateway, CLI, and UI?
rationale: Current docs treat rejected proposals as terminal, and changing that adds new product/API surface and audit semantics beyond a strict bug fix.

options.title: Accept restore lifecycle
options.body: Land the linked candidate or an equivalent implementation with rejected-only validation, cleared rejection metadata, audit/history record, and docs/tests.

options.title: Limit to operator repair
options.body: Expose recovery only through an operator CLI/Gateway repair path if maintainers want to avoid a prominent UI undo action.

options.title: Keep rejection terminal
options.body: Close the feature direction and document the recreate/copy workflow if clean review history is preferred over recovery.

recommendation.title: Accept restore lifecycle
recommendation.body: Land the linked candidate or an equivalent implementation with rejected-only validation, cleared rejection metadata, audit/history record, and docs/tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Skill Workshop lifecycle UX and approval work makes this the closest product-direction owner in the inspected history.
